problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of delivery vehicles from distribution hubs C to retail outlets D in order to minimize total fuel expenditure.

The number of vehicles stationed at each distribution hub (set C) is fixed as follows:  
*C1 has 175 vehicles.  
*C2 has 123 vehicles.  
*C3 has 85 vehicles.  
*C4 has 97 vehicles.  
*C5 has 130 vehicles.  
*C6 has 165 vehicles.  
*C7 has 63 vehicles.  
*C8 has 141 vehicles.  
*C9 has 52 vehicles.

The required number of vehicles at each retail outlet (set D) is predetermined:  
*D1 requires 39 vehicles.  
*D2 requires 76 vehicles.  
*D3 requires 111 vehicles.  
*D4 requires 129 vehicles.  
*D5 requires 81 vehicles.  
*D6 requires 97 vehicles.  
*D7 requires 140 vehicles.  
*D8 requires 87 vehicles.  
*D9 requires 33 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from a given hub to a specific outlet is detailed in the table below:

| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 | D5 | D6 | D7 | D8 | D9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | 19 | 1 | 8 | 10 | 2 | 9 | 8 | 18 | 10 |
| C2 | 6 | 15 | 19 | 16 | 18 | 17 | 4 | 19 | 4 |
| C3 | 9 | 18 | 12 | 18 | 2 | 15 | 18 | 7 | 14 |
| C4 | 4 | 8 | 10 | 2 | 15 | 9 | 12 | 3 | 15 |
| C5 | 4 | 8 | 7 | 19 | 12 | 20 | 14 | 6 | 20 |
| C6 | 5 | 7 | 7 | 2 | 19 | 12 | 18 | 9 | 20 |
| C7 | 18 | 6 | 11 | 10 | 10 | 19 | 9 | 17 | 4 |
| C8 | 5 | 14 | 2 | 9 | 5 | 5 | 8 | 5 | 11 |
| C9 | 8 | 13 | 16 | 5 | 19 | 9 | 14 | 13 | 15 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan that minimizes the aggregate fuel cost.
